mapper.select: SELECT event_id, event_type, payload_digest, result FROM public.auth_consumed_event WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND is_deleted = false LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE public.auth_permission_snapshot snapshot SET status = 'INVALIDATED', updated_by = 0, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = snapshot.version + 1 WHERE snapshot.status = 'ACTIVE' AND snapshot.is_deleted = false AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.auth_device_session session WHERE session.session_id = snapshot.session_id AND session.subject_type = 'TENANT_ACCOUNT' AND session.subject_id = #{accountId} AND session.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND session.is_deleted = false )

UPDATE public.auth_device_session SET status = 'INVALIDATED', updated_by = 0, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE subject_type = 'TENANT_ACCOUNT' AND subject_id = #{accountId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND is_deleted = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.auth_audit_log ( tenant_id, subject_type, subject_id, operator_type, operator_id, action_code, result, trace_id, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, 'TENANT_ACCOUNT', #{accountId}, 'SYSTEM', 0, #{actionCode}, 'SUCCESS', #{traceId}, 0, 0 )
